title: Examining Temporal Patterns and Precise Prediction of Malaria Incidence: An Investigation Utilizing Harmonic and Arima Models with Linear Regressor
content: The 44 Nigerian Army Reference Hospital Kaduna State has no forecast mechanism that can capture incidences of Malaria. The research effectively employs regression model, to both harmonic and ARIMA model, to comprehend and mitigate the prevalence of the incidence of Malaria and clearly showing the existence of seasonality or periodicity, trend and irregular pattern. The Harmonic model with regression performs better than conventional techniques by optimizing the differencing order and using thorough analysis compared to its counterpart as the Harmonic model explains 91% of the variation in Yt leaving only 9% to chance while ARIMA explains 85% of the variation leaving 15% to chance. In order to combat the ongoing rise in Malaria rates, the findings tackled this problem and will assist the 44 Nigeria Army Reference Hospital useful insights, practical measures, advice on resource allocation, enhance budgeting for efficient operations and future projections of the disease.
